Frontline Ophthalmic AI

Advancing the Future of Retinal Screening

NAYAN AI combines advanced deep learning with clinical fundus photography to deliver accessible, point-of-care diabetic retinopathy screening.

Diabetic retinopathy remains one of the primary preventable causes of vision impairment globally. NAYAN AI is engineered to support primary care clinics, regional health networks, and screening centers in identifying sight-threatening retinal changes before irreversible visual loss occurs.

Clinical Screening Concept

Understanding Diabetic Retinopathy

Chronic hyperglycemia progressively weakens retinal microvessels, leading to capillary dropouts, microaneurysms, hemorrhages, and macular edema. Timely screening is critical to preserving visual acuity.

Silent Early Progression

In its initial non-proliferative phases (Mild and Moderate NPDR), diabetic retinopathy often presents zero visual symptoms, making automated screening the most reliable safety net.

Frontline Image Ingestion

Compatible with standard desktop and portable non-mydriatic fundus cameras, allowing non-specialist clinicians to capture diagnostic-quality scans during routine checkups.

Triage & Clinical Referral

Generates instant triage recommendations, flagging patients exhibiting signs of referable retinopathy for urgent evaluation by ophthalmologists and retinal specialists.

Operational Workflow

Standardized Screening Pathway

Designed to seamlessly integrate with existing clinical infrastructure, from outpatient diabetes centers to remote community camps.

1

Image Acquisition

Retinal fundus photography captured using approved digital non-mydriatic or mydriatic fundus imaging hardware.

2

Quality Assurance

Automated validation of image illumination, focus clarity, and field centering to ensure scan gradeability.

3

AI Deep Analysis

Neural networks identify microvascular lesions, exudates, and structural changes across retinal vascular arcades.

4

Actionable Triage

Generates a standardized clinical summary report categorized according to established ICDR screening guidelines.

Engineering & Standards

Engineered for Clinical Confidence

Our core screening architecture leverages deep learning models optimized for high sensitivity to sight-threatening retinopathy.

Computer Vision Architecture

Utilizes multi-scale convolutional and attention-based networks specifically tuned to detect low-contrast retinal lesions against variable choroidal backgrounds.

  • Microaneurysm & dot-blot hemorrhage localization
  • Hard & soft exudate segmentation
  • Macular region and foveal avascular zone inspection

Clinical Workflow Integration

Architected to connect securely with hospital picture archiving systems (PACS) and electronic health records (EHR) through modern healthcare interoperability protocols.

  • Standard DICOM image ingestion & metadata handling
  • HL7 / FHIR clinical screening report export
  • End-to-end data encryption with on-premise or cloud flexibility
Clinical Integrity & Regulatory Note: NAYAN AI software modules are designed to assist healthcare professionals in high-volume triage. Performance parameters, clinical sensitivities, and regulatory clearances are established through rigorous protocol-defined multi-center evaluations and regional regulatory submissions. Technical specifications are customizable for research and clinical validation partners.
